description: This elegant Parisian apartment has recently been redesigned to combine its period features with a discreet ultra-modern touch. The apartment has three bedrooms and three bathrooms. It has two toilets.The spaceThe large kitchen-dining room area is ideal for dinners and evenings, with its long table and views of the Luxembourg Garden creating a dreamy bohemian atmosphere. This apartment has been designed to spend as much time as possible, the high-end amenities are legion.Guest accessWhen you're not hanging out in your luxurious apartment, go down the spiral staircase (or take the elevator) to get out and explore your neighborhood.You are at the foot of the metro: Notre Dame des Champs. You have many restaurants, shops, bars and cozy cafes right in front, while the Raspail Organic Market takes place every Sunday at the bottom of your home. Le Bon Marché and most of Paris' attractions are also just a few minutes' walk from your door. – hotel-type listing
